verdict.summary: The new ring-efficiency signal is sound and conservatively bounded by the artifact horizon: it counts only concluded dispatch runs for which marker visibility is adjudicable, treats insufficient or zero-execution samples as unknown, and preserves live alerts when evidence is unknown. The alert path reuses the existing two API payloads, keeps the existing fail-closed issue-list behavior and authority ceiling, and exercises the new sampling, threshold boundary, unknown/no-close behavior, live call site, request count, and end-to-end issue creation with non-vacuous assertions. Cross-file checks bind the ratio's structural premise to the live dispatch floor and cron. I found no correctness, security, or trust-check regression in the diff.
